appt.subtitle: Passports, biometrics and everything else
appt.label: What is the appointment for?
appt.passport.leadSub: Book one to plan your visit. Appointments depend on availability, and most locations also serve you without one.
appt.passport.1: Fill in your forms before your appointment and bring your supporting documents. Online booking ends after 30 minutes without activity.
appt.passport.2: Need it by the end of the next business day? Walk in to a location that offers urgent pick-up.
appt.passport.3: Renewing an adult passport and don’t need it for at least 20 business days plus mailing?
appt.passport.3.link: You may be able to renew online
appt.biometrics.lead: You need an appointment to give biometrics.
appt.biometrics.leadSub: Booking takes about 5 to 15 minutes on eServiceCanada; the session ends after 30 minutes without activity.
appt.biometrics.1: Have the application number from your Biometric Instruction Letter ready to book.
appt.biometrics.2: Bring your Biometric Instruction Letter to the appointment.
appt.biometrics.3: Bring the passport or travel document you used in your application.
appt.other.lead: Most centres need no appointment: walk in.
appt.other.leadSub: Most Service Canada Centres serve walk-ins during opening hours. Rather not wait? Ask for a call back: an officer calls within 2 business days and books a visit if you need one.
appt.other.1: A few centres take appointments only, like Kingston. The office finder flags them, with the number to call.
appt.other.2: Asking for a call back? Choose your language of service, including ASL or LSQ. The call may come from a blocked or private number.
appt.other.3: Don’t type your SIN, date of birth, or financial or medical details in the comments box.
